title: prompts.chat launches biggest free AI prompt library #promptschat #AIlibrary #AImodels
description: prompts.chat launched the world’s largest free, open-source AI prompt library with over 10,000 prompts spanning writing, coding, image generation, video, and research. It includes ready-made skills and workflows suitable for writers, developers, designers, and researchers. The library integrates with Claude Code as an MCP server, enabling automated selection of the ideal prompt for any task. This innovation reduces time spent copying, pasting, and searching through old notes or bookmarks, streamlining creative and technical workflows. With tested prompts for a wide range of applications, prompts.chat empowers users to increase efficiency and creativity in content creation and development across diverse industries. #promptschat #AIpromptlibrary #ClaudeCode #AIAutomation #OpenSourceAI #AIPrompts #ArtificialIntelligence #PromptEngineering #MachineLearning #AITools #CreativeTech #CodingPrompts #ImageGeneration #ResearchTools #ProductivityAI
